scope: Documentation only following explicit user clarification; no roles or GRANT/REVOKE migrations
caveats: Static SQL candidates may contain CTE/alias names and miss dynamic or transitive operations; not a grant allowlist
Function header annotations do not prove effective SECURITY DEFINER/search_path/ACL after later migrations or deployment ownership changes
Trigger candidates omit names generated dynamically; serial OIDs/catalog owners were not queried
Targeted reading plus static scans is not independent full source review, role acceptance, live catalog inspection or penetration testing
Only literal write/lock navigation sites are exported to keep the draft reviewable; all selected source files were parsed, but the index omits pure read sites and is not an entitlement specification

validation.design_checks: JSON/AST parse of scanned source, file-reference/hash/whitespace/secret-pattern checks; no runtime acceptance
